Wang Li and Zhao Li are friends who meet online, they talk about everything and often video chat. Recently, they prepare for their first offline meeting.

B. Wang Li fears that Zhao Li may not like him anymore after the meeting.

D. Wang Li worries that Zhao Li may have a bad impression of his appearance.
